sources.snippet: Quran 49:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ. English: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.. Urdu: مومنو! (کسی بات کے جواب میں) خدا اور اس کے رسول سے پہلے نہ بول اٹھا کرو اور خدا سے ڈرتے رہو۔ بےشک خدا سنتا جانتا ہے.

Tafsir ibn_kathir_en 49:1: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ - يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَنْ تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَاتَهُمْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَ…
Tafsir maududi_ur 49:1: اے لوگو جو ایمان لائے ہو، اللہ اور اس کے رسول کے آگے پیش قدمی نہ کرو اور اللہ سے ڈرو، اللہ سب کچھ سننے اور جاننے والا ہے

Tafsir maududi_ur 51:1: قسم ہے اُن ہواؤں کی جو گرد اڑانے والی ہیں

Tafsir ibn_kathir_en 58:10: Have you not seen those who were forbidden to hold secret counsels, and afterwards returned to that which they had been forbidden, and conspired together for sin and wrongdoing and disobedience to the Messenger. And when they come to you, they greet you with a greeting wherewith Allah greets you not, and say within themselves: "Why should Allah punish us not for what we say?" Hell will be sufficient for them; they will enter therein. And worst indeed is that destination (8)O you who believe! When you hold secret counsel, do it not for sin and wrongdoing, and disobe…

Tafsir maududi_ur 60:1: اے لوگو جو ایمان لائے ہو، اگر تم میری راہ میں جہاد کرنے کے لیے اور میری رضا جوئی کی خاطر (وطن چھوڑ کر گھروں سے) نکلے ہو تو میرے اور اپنے دشمنوں کو دوست نہ بناؤ تم اُن کے ساتھ دوستی کی طرح ڈالتے ہو، حالانکہ جو حق تمہارے پاس آیا ہے اُس کو ماننے سے وہ انکار کر چکے ہیں اور اُن کی روش یہ ہے کہ رسول کو اور خود تم کو صرف اِس قصور پر جلا وطن کرتے ہیں کہ تم اپنے رب، اللہ پر ایمان لائے ہو تم چھپا کر اُن کو دوستانہ پیغام بھیجتے ہو، حالانکہ جو کچھ تم چھپا کر کرتے ہو اور جو علانیہ کرتے ہو، ہر چیز کو میں خوب جانتا ہوں جو شخص بھی تم میں سے ایسا کرے وہ یقیناً راہ راست سے بھٹک گیا

English: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allah, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allah?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allah." Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ قَالُوا۟ نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَكَٰذِبُونَ. English: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muhammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allah." Urdu: (اے محمدﷺ) جب منافق لوگ تمہارے پاس آتے ہیں تو (از راہ نفاق) کہتے ہیں کہ ہم اقرار کرتے ہیں کہ آپ بےشک خدا کے پیغمبر ہیں اور خدا جانتا ہے کہ درحقیقت تم…

Tafsir ibn_kathir_en 63:1: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ قَالُوا نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُ وَاللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَكَاذِبُونَ - اتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ - ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ - وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ يَقُولُوا تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ ۖ كَأَنَّهُم…

Tafsir maududi_ur 63:1: اے نبیؐ، جب یہ منافق تمہارے پاس آتے ہیں تو کہتے ہیں "ہم گواہی دیتے ہیں کہ آ پ یقیناً اللہ کے رسول ہیں" ہاں، اللہ جانتا ہے کہ تم ضرور اُس کے رسول ہو، مگر اللہ گواہی دیتا ہے کہ یہ منافق قطعی جھوٹے ہیں

So they disbelieved and turned away. But Allah was not in need. English: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.. Urdu: مومنو! تمہاری عورتیں اور اولاد میں سے بعض تمہارے دشمن (بھی) ہیں سو ان سے بچتے رہو۔ اور اگر معاف کردو اور درگزر کرو اور بخش دو تو خدا بھی بخشنے والا مہربان ہے.

Tafsir ibn_kathir_en 64:14: O you who believe! Verily, among your wives and your children there are enemies for you; therefore beware of them! With Him is a great reward (15)So have Taqwa of Allah as much as you can; listen and obey, and spend in charity; that is better for yourselves. And whosoever is saved from his own greed, then they are the successful ones (16)If you lend to Allah a handsome loan, He will double it for…
Tafsir maududi_ur 64:14: اے لوگو جو ایمان لائے ہو، تمہاری بیویوں اور تمہاری اولاد میں سے بعض تمہارے دشمن ہیں، ان سے ہوشیار رہو اور اگر تم عفو و درگزر سے کام لو اور معاف کر دو تو اللہ غفور و رحیم ہے

English: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allah showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Acquainted."…

Tafsir ibn_kathir_en 66:3: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ (In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَاجِكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ - قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَانِكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ - وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِ وَأَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنْ بَعْضٍ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنْبَأَكَ هَٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ الْ…

Tafsir maududi_ur 66:3: (اور یہ معاملہ بھی قابل توجہ ہے کہ) نبیؐ نے ایک بات اپنی ایک بیوی سے راز میں کہی تھی پھر جب اُس بیوی نے (کسی اور پر) وہ راز ظاہر کر دیا، اور اللہ نے نبیؐ کو اِس (افشائے راز) کی اطلاع دے دی، تو نبیؐ نے اس پر کسی حد تک (اُس بیوی کو) خبردار کیا اور کسی حد تک اس سے درگزر کیا پھر جب نبیؐ نے اُسے (افشائے راز کی) یہ بات بتائی تو اُس نے پوچھا آپ کو اِس کی کس نے خبر دی؟ نبیؐ نے کہا، "مجھے اُس نے خبر دی جو سب کچھ جانتا ہے اور خوب باخبر ہے"

Tafsir maududi_ur 86:1: قسم ہے آسمان کی اور رات کو نمودار ہونے والے کی

sources.snippet: Quran 98:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ. English: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -. Urdu: جو لوگ کافر ہیں (یعنی) اہل کتاب اور مشرک وہ (کفر سے) باز رہنے والے نہ تھے جب تک ان کے پاس کھلی دلیل (نہ) آتی.

Each one believes in Allah, His Angels, His Books, and His Messengers. (They say,) "We make no distinction between one another of His Messengers ـ and they say, "We hear, and we obey. (We seek) Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the return (of all). (285)Allah burdens not a person beyond his scope. He gets reward for that (good) which he has earned, and he is punished for that (evil) which he has earned. "Our Lord! Punish us not if we forget or fall into error,…

Tafsir maududi_ur 2:286: اللہ کسی متنفس پر اُس کی مقدرت سے بڑھ کر ذمہ داری کا بوجھ نہیں ڈالتا ہر شخص نے جو نیکی کمائی ہے، اس کا پھل اسی کے لیے ہے اور جو بدی سمیٹی ہے، اس کا وبال اسی پر ہے (ایمان لانے والو! تم یوں دعا کیا کرو) اے ہمارے رب! ہم سے بھول چوک میں جو قصور ہو جائیں، ان پر گرفت نہ کر مالک! ہم پر وہ بوجھ نہ ڈال، جو تو نے ہم سے پہلے لوگوں پر ڈالے تھے پروردگار! جس بار کو اٹھانے کی طاقت ہم میں نہیں ہے، وہ ہم پر نہ رکھ، ہمارے ساتھ نرمی کر، ہم سے در گزر فرما، ہم پر رحم کر، تو ہمارا مولیٰ ہے، کافروں کے مقابلے میں ہماری مدد کر

Tafsir maududi_ur 5:6: اے لوگو جو ایمان لائے ہو، جب تم نماز کے لیے اٹھو تو چاہیے کہ اپنے منہ اور ہاتھ کہنیوں تک دھو لو، سروں پر ہاتھ پھیر لو اور پاؤں ٹخنوں تک دھو لیا کرو اگر جنابت کی حالت میں ہو تو نہا کر پاک ہو جاؤ اگر بیمار ہو یا سفر کی حالت میں ہو یا تم میں سے کوئی شخص رفع حاجت کر کے آئے یا تم نے عورتوں کو ہاتھ لگایا ہو، اور پانی نہ ملے، تو پاک مٹی سے کام لو، بس اُس پر ہاتھ مار کر اپنے منہ اور ہاتھوں پر پھیر لیا کرو اللہ تم پر زندگی کو تنگ نہیں کرنا چاہتا، مگر وہ چاہتا ہے کہ تمہیں پاک کرے اور اپنی نعمت تم پر تمام کر دے، شاید کہ تم شکر گزار بنو

Tafsir maududi_ur 24:35: اللہ آسمانوں اور زمین کا نور ہے (کائنات میں) اس کے نور کی مثال ایسی ہے جیسے ایک طاق میں چراغ رکھا ہوا ہو، چراغ ایک فانوس میں ہو، فانوس کا حال یہ ہو کہ جیسے موتی کی طرح چمکتا ہوا تارا، اور وہ چراغ زیتون کے ایک ایسے مبارک درخت کے تیل سے روشن کیا جاتا ہو جو شرقی ہو نہ غربی، جس کا تیل آپ ہی آپ بھڑکا پڑتا ہو چاہے آگ اس کو نہ لگے، (اِس طرح) روشنی پر روشنی (بڑھنے کے تمام اسباب جمع ہو گئے ہوں) اللہ اپنے نور کی طرف جس کی چاہتا ہے رہنمائی فرماتا ہے، وہ لوگوں کو مثالوں سے بات سمجھاتا ہے، وہ ہر چیز سے خوب واقف ہے

q-3059.answer: There is no single fixed 'exam dua' in the Quran, but Muslims often ask Allah for knowledge and ease — especially the dua in Surah Ta-Ha (20:114): 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge.' See sources for related verses and hadith on seeking knowledge.

q-3060.answer: There is no single fixed 'exam dua' in the Quran, but Muslims often ask Allah for knowledge and ease — especially the dua in Surah Ta-Ha (20:114): 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge.' See sources for related verses and hadith on seeking knowledge.

q-3061.answer: The Quran reminds us that with hardship comes ease (94:5–6) and that hearts find rest in the remembrance of Allah (13:28). Trust in Allah eases worry and grief.

q-3063.answer: The Quran describes marriage as a bond of love and mercy between spouses (30:21). Believers pray for righteous partners and tranquil homes (25:74).

q-3071.answer: Before sleep, the Prophet ﷺ would recite Surah Al-Mulk (67), Ayat al-Kursi (2:255), and the last three surahs — Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas (112–114) — then blow into his palms and wipe over his body. Al-Mulk is widely recommended for protection from the punishment of the grave; the three Quls seek Allah's protection through the night.

q-3075.answer:
Here are relevant duas from our collection:

• Dua when leaving home (Dua travel-1)
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah
(Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallahi la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah)
Source: Sunan Abu Dawud 5095, Tirmidhi 3426

sources.snippet: Dua travel-1: Dua when leaving home. Arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ. Transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallahi la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. English: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.. Urdu: اللہ کے نام سے، میں نے اللہ پر بھروسہ کیا۔ اللہ کے سوا نہ کوئی طاقت ہے نہ قوت۔. Source: Sunan Abu Dawud 5095, Tirmidhi 3426

Quran 2:94. Arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَتْ لَكُمُ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَالِصَةًۭ مِّن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا۟ ٱلْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ. English: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the home of the Hereafter with Allah is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful.. Urdu: کہہ دو کہ اگر آخرت کا گھر اور لوگوں (یعنی مسلمانوں) کے لیے نہیں اور خدا کے نزدیک تمہارے ہی لیے مخصوص ہے تو اگر سچے ہو تو موت کی آرزو تو کرو.

Quran 2:49. Arabic: وَإِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌۭ. English: And [recall] when We saved your forefathers from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.. Urdu: اور (ہمارے ان احسانات کو یاد کرو) جب ہم نے تم کو قومِ فرعون سے نجات بخشی وہ (لوگ) تم کو بڑا دکھ دیتے تھے تمہارے بیٹوں کو تو قتل کر ڈالتے تھے اور بیٹیوں…

Quran 2:60. Arabic: ۞ وَإِذِ ٱسْتَسْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْحَجَرَ ۖ فَٱنفَجَرَتْ مِنْهُ ٱثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًۭا ۖ قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍۢ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ ۖ كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ. English: And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." q-3083.answer:
Here are relevant duas from our collection:

• Dua when leaving home (Dua travel-1)
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah
(Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallahi la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah)
Source: Sunan Abu Dawud 5095, Tirmidhi 3426

• Dua for travel (Surah Al-Mulk) (Dua travel-2)
تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent
(Tabarakalladhi biyadihil-mulku wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir)
Source: Quran 67:1

q-3105.answer:
Here are relevant duas from our collection:

• Dua when leaving home (Dua travel-1)
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah
(Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallahi la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah)
Source: Sunan Abu Dawud 5095, Tirmidhi 3426

• Dua for travel (Surah Al-Mulk) (Dua travel-2)
تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent
(Tabarakalladhi biyadihil-mulku wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir)
Source: Quran 67:1

Urdu: اللہ کے نام سے، میں نے اللہ پر بھروسہ کیا۔ اللہ کے سوا نہ کوئی طاقت ہے نہ قوت۔. Source: Sunan Abu Dawud 5095, Tirmidhi 3426

Dua travel-2: Dua for travel (Surah Al-Mulk). Arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. Transliteration: Tabarakalladhi biyadihil-mulku wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. English: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent.. Urdu: بڑی برکت والا ہے وہ جس کے ہاتھ میں بادشاہی ہے اور وہ ہر چیز پر قادر ہے۔. Source: Quran 67:1

Dua travel-3: Dua during travel — patience and gratitude. Arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ. Transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakallati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardah. English: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve.. Urdu: اے میرے رب! مجھے اپنی نعمتوں کا شکر ادا کرنے کی توفیق دے جو تو نے مجھ پر اور میرے والدین پر کی ہیں اور نیک عمل کرنے کی توفیق…

Dua travel-4: Dua for safety on the journey. Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ. Transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa wa minal-'amali ma tarda. English: O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that are pleasing to You.. Urdu: اے اللہ! ہم اس سفر میں تجھ سے نیکی اور تقویٰ مانگتے ہیں اور ایسے اعمال جو تجھے پسند ہوں۔. Source: Muslim 1342

Dua travel-5: Dua when mounting a vehicle. Arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ. Transliteration: Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. English: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our efforts. Surely, to our Lord we will return.. Urdu: پاک ہے وہ جس نے اسے ہمارے لیے مسخر کیا اور ہم خود اس پر قابو نہ پا سکتے تھے، اور ہم اپنے رب کی طرف لوٹنے والے ہیں۔. Source: Quran 43:13-14

sources.snippet:
Sahih al-Bukhari 25. Chapter: Belief. English: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "I have been ordered (by Allah) to fight against
     the people until they testify that none has the right to be worshipped
     but Allah and that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and offer the prayers 
     perfectly and give the obligatory charity, so if they perform that, 
     then they save their lives and property from me except for Islamic laws
     and then their reckoning (accounts) will be done by Allah.".

Sahih al-Bukhari 40. Chapter: Belief. English: Narrated Al-Bara' (bin 'Azib): When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina, he stayed first with his grandfathers
     or maternal uncles from Ansar. He offered his prayers facing 
     Baitul-Maqdis (Jerusalem) for sixteen or seventeen months, but he 
     wished that he could pray facing the Ka'ba (at Mecca). The first 
     prayer which he offered facing the Ka'ba was the 'Asr prayer in the 
     company of some people. Then one of those who had offered that prayer 
     with him came out and passed by some people in a mosque who were 
     bowing dur…

Sahih al-Bukhari 8. Chapter: Belief. English: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Islam is based on (the following) five 
     (principles):


     1. To testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and 
     Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).


     2. To offer the (compulsory congregational) prayers dutifully and 
     perfectly.


     3. To pay Zakat (i.e. obligatory charity) .


     4. To perform Hajj. (i.e. Pilgrimage to Mecca)


     5. To observe fast during the month of Ramadan..

Sahih al-Bukhari 35. Chapter: Belief. English: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever establishes the prayers on the night of
     Qadr out of sincere faith and hoping to attain Allah's rewards (not to
     show off) then all his past sins will be forgiven.".

Sahih al-Bukhari 37. Chapter: Belief. English: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "Whoever establishes prayers during the nights 
     of Ramadan faithfully out of sincere faith and hoping to attain 
     Allah's rewards (not for showing off), all his past sins will be 
     forgiven.".

And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor

sources.snippet: Quran 9:92. Arabic: وَلَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا مَآ أَتَوْكَ لِتَحْمِلَهُمْ قُلْتَ لَآ أَجِدُ مَآ أَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ تَوَلَّوا۟ وَّأَعْيُنُهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعِ حَزَنًا أَلَّا يَجِدُوا۟ مَا يُنفِقُونَ. English: Nor [is there blame] upon those who, when they came to you that you might give them mounts, you said, "I can find nothing for you to ride upon." They turned back while their eyes overflowed with tears out of grief that they could not find something to spend [for the cause of Allah].. Urdu: اور نہ ان (بےسروسامان) لوگوں پر (الزام) ہے کہ تمہارے پاس آئے کہ ان کو سواری دو اور تم…

Quran 12:84. Arabic: وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌۭ. English: And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.. Urdu: پھر ان کے پاس سے چلے گئے اور کہنے لگے ہائے افسوس یوسف (ہائے افسوس) اور رنج والم میں (اس قدر روئے کہ) ان کی آنکھیں سفید ہوگئیں اور ان کا دل غم سے بھر رہا تھا.

Quran 12:86. Arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ. English: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know.. Urdu: انہوں نے کہا کہ میں اپنے غم واندوہ کا اظہار خدا سے کرتا ہوں۔ اور خدا کی طرف سے وہ باتیں جانتا ہوں جو تم نہیں جانتے.

Quran 16:58. Arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌۭ. English: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.. Urdu: حالانکہ جب ان میں سے کسی کو بیٹی (کے پیدا ہونے) کی خبر ملتی ہے تو اس کا منہ (غم کے سبب) کالا پڑ جاتا ہے اور (اس کے دل کو دیکھو تو) وہ اندوہناک ہوجاتا ہے.

Quran 18:6. Arabic: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا. English: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.. Urdu: (اے پیغمبر) اگر یہ اس کلام پر ایمان نہ لائیں تو شاید تم کے ان پیچھے رنج کر کر کے اپنے تئیں ہلاک کردو گے.

q-3152.answer: The Quran addresses fighting (qital) in specific contexts — not as unrestricted violence. Allah says: 'Fight in the cause of Allah those who fight you, but do not transgress' (2:190). In Surah Al Imran, believers are told that those who fight in Allah's cause and are killed or victorious receive a great reward (3:157, 3:169, 3:195). Scholars explain these verses with their historical context in tafsir — see the cited ayahs and Ibn Kathir commentary below.

q-3155.answer:
Here are relevant duas from our collection:

• Dua when leaving home (Dua travel-1)
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah
(Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallahi la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah)
Source: Sunan Abu Dawud 5095, Tirmidhi 3426

• Dua for travel (Surah Al-Mulk) (Dua travel-2)
تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent
(Tabarakalladhi biyadihil-mulku wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir)
Source: Quran 67:1

Transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallahi la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. English: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.. Urdu: اللہ کے نام سے، میں نے اللہ پر بھروسہ کیا۔ اللہ کے سوا نہ کوئی طاقت ہے نہ قوت۔. Source: Sunan Abu Dawud 5095, Tirmidhi 3426

Dua travel-2: Dua for travel (Surah Al-Mulk). Arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. Transliteration: Tabarakalladhi biyadihil-mulku wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. English: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent.. Urdu: بڑی برکت والا ہے وہ جس کے ہاتھ میں بادشاہی ہے اور وہ ہر چیز پر قادر ہے۔. Source: Quran 67:1

Dua travel-3: Dua during travel — patience and gratitude. Arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ. Transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakallati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardah. English: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve.. Urdu: اے میرے رب! مجھے اپنی نعمتوں کا شکر ادا کرنے کی توفیق دے جو تو نے مجھ پر اور میرے والدین پر کی ہیں اور نیک عمل کرنے کی توفیق…

Dua travel-4: Dua for safety on the journey. Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ. Transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa wa minal-'amali ma tarda. English: O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that are pleasing to You.. Urdu: اے اللہ! ہم اس سفر میں تجھ سے نیکی اور تقویٰ مانگتے ہیں اور ایسے اعمال جو تجھے پسند ہوں۔. Source: Muslim 1342

Dua travel-5: Dua when mounting a vehicle. Arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ. Transliteration: Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. English: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our efforts. Surely, to our Lord we will return.. Urdu: پاک ہے وہ جس نے اسے ہمارے لیے مسخر کیا اور ہم خود اس پر قابو نہ پا سکتے تھے، اور ہم اپنے رب کی طرف لوٹنے والے ہیں۔. Source: Quran 43:13-14

     1. To testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and 
     Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).


     2. To offer the (compulsory congregational) prayers dutifully and 
     perfectly.


     3. To pay Zakat (i.e. obligatory charity) .


     4. To perform Hajj. (i.e. Pilgrimage to Mecca)


     5. To observe fast during the month of Ramadan..

Sahih al-Bukhari 35. Chapter: Belief. English: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever establishes the prayers on the night of
     Qadr out of sincere faith and hoping to attain Allah's rewards (not to
     show off) then all his past sins will be forgiven.".

Sahih al-Bukhari 37. Chapter: Belief. English: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "Whoever establishes prayers during the nights 
     of Ramadan faithfully out of sincere faith and hoping to attain 
     Allah's rewards (not for showing off), all his past sins will be 
     forgiven.".

q-3163.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:8
And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah and the Last Day," but they are not believers

• Quran 2:11
And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."

• Quran 2:13
And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not

q-3165.answer: Sabr (patience) is praised throughout the Quran (2:153, 3:200). Believers are told that Allah is with the patient and that trials are a path to spiritual growth.

sources.snippet: Quran 2:153. Arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ. English: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.. Urdu: اے ایمان والو صبر اور نماز سے مدد لیا کرو بےشک خدا صبر کرنے والوں کے ساتھ ہے.
Sahih al-Bukhari 1260. Chapter: Funerals (Al-Janaa'iz). English: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The real patience is at the first stroke of a calamity.".

Quran 2:155. Arabic: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُم بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْخَوْفِ وَٱلْجُوعِ وَنَقْصٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَنفُسِ وَٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ. English: And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient,. Urdu: اور ہم کسی قدر خوف اور بھوک اور مال اور جانوں اور میوؤں کے نقصان سے تمہاری آزمائش کریں گے توصبر کرنے والوں کو (خدا کی خوشنودی کی) بشارت سنا دو.

Quran 3:200. Arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱصْبِرُوا۟ وَصَابِرُوا۟ وَرَابِطُوا۟ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ. English: O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.. Urdu: اے اہل ایمان (کفار کے مقابلے میں) ثابت قدم رہو اور استقامت رکھو اور مورچوں پر جمے رہو اور خدا سے ڈرو تاکہ مراد حاصل کرو.

q-3185.answer:
Surah Al-Qadr (97) — The Power, Fate · 5 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Descent of the Angels and the Decree for Every Good during the Night of Al-Qadr
• The angels descend in abundance during the Night of Al-Qadr due to its abundant blessings.
• Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
• And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
• The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 97:1. Arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ. English: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.. Urdu: ہم نے اس (قرآن) کو شب قدر میں نازل (کرنا شروع) کیا.
Quran 97:2. Arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ. English: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?. Urdu: اور تمہیں کیا معلوم کہ شب قدر کیا ہے؟.
Quran 97:3. Arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ. English: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.. Urdu: شب قدر ہزار مہینے سے بہتر ہے.

Quran 97:4. Arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ. English: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.. Urdu: اس میں روح (الامین) اور فرشتے ہر کام کے (انتظام کے) لیے اپنے پروردگار کے حکم سے اترتے ہیں.
Quran 97:5. Arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ. English: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.. Urdu: یہ (رات) طلوع صبح تک (امان اور) سلامتی ہے.

q-3191.answer:
Surah Al-Jinn (72) — The Jinn · 28 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Jinns Affirmation that Allah does not have a Wife and Children
• The Jinns confess to Allah's Perfect Power
• Power to harm or give Guidance
• He particularly gives him additional guardian angels who protect him by the command of Allah and they accompany him with that which is with him of Allah's revelation.
• Among the Causes of the Transgression of the Jinns were that Humans sought Refuge with Them

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 72:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا. English: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.. Urdu: (اے پیغمبر لوگوں سے) کہہ دو کہ میرے پاس وحی آئی ہے کہ جنوں کی ایک جماعت نے (اس کتاب کو) سنا تو کہنے لگے کہ ہم نے ایک عجیب قرآن سنا.

Quran 72:2. Arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا. English: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.. Urdu: جو بھلائی کا رستہ بتاتا ہے سو ہم اس پر ایمان لے آئے۔ اور ہم اپنے پروردگار کے ساتھ کسی کو شریک نہیں بنائیں گے.

Quran 72:3. Arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا. English: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son. Urdu: اور یہ کہ ہمارے پروردگار کی عظمت (شان) بہت بڑی ہے اور وہ نہ بیوی رکھتا ہے نہ اولاد.

Quran 72:14. Arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا. English: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.. Urdu: اور یہ کہ ہم میں بعض فرمانبردار ہیں اور بعض (نافرمان) گنہگار ہیں۔ تو جو فرمانبردار ہوئے وہ سیدھے رستے پر چلے.

Quran 72:27. Arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا. English: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers. Urdu: ہاں جس پیغمبر کو پسند فرمائے تو اس (کو غیب کی باتیں بتا دیتا اور اس) کے آگے اور پیچھے نگہبان مقرر کر دیتا ہے.

Tafsir maududi_ur 4:43: اے لوگو جو ایمان لائے ہو، جب تم نشے کی حالت میں ہو تو نماز کے قریب نہ جاؤ نماز اُس وقت پڑھنی چاہیے، جب تم جانو کہ کیا کہہ رہے ہو اور اسی طرح جنابت کی حالت میں بھی نماز کے قریب نہ جاؤ جب تک کہ غسل نہ کر لو، الا یہ کہ راستہ سے گزرتے ہو اور اگر کبھی ایسا ہو کہ تم بیمار ہو، یا سفر میں ہو، یا تم میں سے کوئی شخص رفع حاجت کر کے آئے، یا تم نے عورتوں سے لمس کیا ہو، اور پھر پانی نہ ملے تو پاک مٹی سے کام لو اور اس سے اپنے چہروں اور ہاتھوں پر مسح کر لو، بے شک اللہ نرمی سے کام لینے والا اور بخشش فرمانے والا ہے

q-4506.answer:
Surah Al-An'aam (6) — The Cattle · 165 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• In spite of all this, some of Allah's servants disbelieve in Him and hold others as partners and rivals with Him.
• Proof, according to Ibn 'Abbas and others among the Salaf.
• What will make you preceive, O believers, that the idolators will still not believe if the signs come.
• He made you dwell on the earth generation after generation, century after century and offspring after forefathers, according to Ibn Zayd and others.
• It is He Who is called Allah, throughout the heavens and the earth, that is, it is He who is worshipped, singled out, whose divinity is believed in by the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 6:1. q-4518.answer:
Surah Al-Kahf (18) — The Cave · 110 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• To those who oppose His Prophet ﷺ and disbelieve in His Book, He issues a warning of severe punishment hastened in this world and postponed to the world Hereafter.
• Their overwhelming punishment, destroying every last one of them.
• This thing that I did deliberately is one of the things I told you not to denounce me for, because you do not know the full story, and there is a reason and purpose for it that you do not know about.
• It has no basis apart from what they say, and they have no evidence for it apart from their own lies and fabrications.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

Surah Ash-Shura (42) — Consultation · 53 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

q-4554.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4566.answer:
Surah At-Tahrim (66) — The Prohibition · 12 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• On the Day of Resurrection, the disbeliever will be told, "Do not offer any excuse this Day, because it will not be accepted from you; you will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
• Through the angel Jibril. Allah sent the angel Jibril to Maryam, and he came to her in the shape of a man in every respect.
• The keepers and guards of Hell, may Allah give us shelter from them.
• A true, firm repentance that erases the evil sins that preceded it and mend the shortcoming of the repenting person, encouraging and directing him to quit the evil that he used to do.
• Whatever Allah commands them, they rush to obey Him, without delay for even a twinkling of an eye.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4578.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4586.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4590.answer:
Surah Al-Balad (90) — The City · 20 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Man is encompassed by Allah and His Bounties
• He was from the believers who worked righteous deeds, and advised each other to be patient with the harms of the people, and to be merciful with them.
• Then, along with these beautiful and pure characteristics, he was a believer in his heart, seeking the reward of that from Allah.
• It will be sealed over them and there will be no way for them to avoid it, nor will they have any way out.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4602.answer:
Surah At-Takaathur (102) — Competition · 8 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Result of Loving the World and Heedlessness of the Hereafter
• If you knew with true knowledge, you would not be diverted by rivalry for wealth away from seeking the abode of the Hereafter until you reach the graves.
• On that Day you all will be questioned concerning your gratitude towards the favors that Allah blessed you with, such as health, safety, sustenance and other things.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Quran 102:4. Arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ. English: Then no! You are going to know.. Urdu: پھر دیکھو تمہیں عنقریب معلوم ہو جائے گا.

q-4622.answer:
Surah Al-Anfaal (8) — The Spoils of War · 75 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• The Angels smite the Disbelievers upon capturing Their Souls
• In Allah's decision. This Ayah encompasses all relatives, not only the degrees of relative who do not have a fixed, designated share in the inheritance, as some people claim and use this Ayah to argue.
• This punishment is the recompense of the evil deeds that you have committed in the life of the world.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4626.answer: The story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) teaches patience through severe trials — betrayal by brothers, slavery, false accusation, and imprisonment — yet trust in Allah. He said: 'Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good' (12:90). The surah concludes: 'There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding' (12:111). See sources for key ayahs.

q-4638.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

Quran 2:16. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ. English: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.. Urdu: یہ وہ لوگ ہیں جنہوں نے ہدایت چھوڑ کر گمراہی خریدی، تو نہ تو ان کی تجارت ہی نے کچھ نفع دیا اور نہ وہ ہدایت یاب ہی ہوئے.

Quran 2:38. Arabic: قُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًۭى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ. q-4650.answer:
Surah Yaseen (36) — Yaseen · 83 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Until a time that is known to Allah, may He be glorified and exalted.
• The like of mankind. So, He will re-create them as He created them in the first place.
• He only needs to command a thing once; it does not need to be repeated or confirmed.

q-4670.answer:
Surah Al-Waaqia (56) — The Inevitable · 96 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Relentlessly pulverized. This was said by Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid, 'Ikrimah and Qatadah and others.
• We caused the seeds to grow with Our compassion and mercy and left them intact inside the earth as mercy for you.
• The angels will deliver the good news to them by saying, "Peace be upon you," i.
• It is shaken and moved violently over all of its surface and through its depths.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4674.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

q-4686.answer:
Surah Al-Jinn (72) — The Jinn · 28 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Jinns Affirmation that Allah does not have a Wife and Children
• The Jinns confess to Allah's Perfect Power
• Power to harm or give Guidance
• He particularly gives him additional guardian angels who protect him by the command of Allah and they accompany him with that which is with him of Allah's revelation.
• Among the Causes of the Transgression of the Jinns were that Humans sought Refuge with Them

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 72:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا. English: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.. Urdu: (اے پیغمبر لوگوں سے) کہہ دو کہ میرے پاس وحی آئی ہے کہ جنوں کی ایک جماعت نے (اس کتاب کو) سنا تو کہنے لگے کہ ہم نے ایک عجیب قرآن سنا.

Quran 72:2. Arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا. English: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. q-4698.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4706.answer:
Surah Al-Lail (92) — The Night · 21 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Proving that Allah rewards those who intend good with success, while whoever intends evil is abandoned, and all of this is in accordance with a preordained decree.
• Hoping to attain the blessing of seeing Him in the final abode in the Gardens of Paradise.
• The recompense in the abode of the Hereafter.
• The righteous, pure, most pious person will be saved from the Fire.
• The actions of the servants that they have performed are also opposites and diverse.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4710.answer:
Surah Al-Alaq (96) — The Clot · 19 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• `indeed We will make it extremely black on the Day of Judgement.
• `unto Allah is the final destination and return, and He will hold you accountable for your wealth, as to where you obtained it from and how did you spend it.
• `O Muhammad! Do not obey him in what he is forbidding from such as steadfastness in worship and performing worship in abundance.
• His people and his tribe. In other words, let him call them in order to seek help from them.

Surah Al-Kawthar (108) — Abundance · 3 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Indeed he who hates you, O Muhammad, and he hates what you have come with of guidance, truth, clear proof and manifest light, he is the most cut off, meanest, lowliest person who will not be remembered.
• Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
• So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
• Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

Surah Al-An'aam (6) — The Cattle · 165 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• In spite of all this, some of Allah's servants disbelieve in Him and hold others as partners and rivals with Him.
• Proof, according to Ibn 'Abbas and others among the Salaf.
• What will make you preceive, O believers, that the idolators will still not believe if the signs come.
• He made you dwell on the earth generation after generation, century after century and offspring after forefathers, according to Ibn Zayd and others.
• It is He Who is called Allah, throughout the heavens and the earth, that is, it is He who is worshipped, singled out, whose divinity is believed in by the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4746.answer:
Surah Al-Kahf (18) — The Cave · 110 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• To those who oppose His Prophet ﷺ and disbelieve in His Book, He issues a warning of severe punishment hastened in this world and postponed to the world Hereafter.
• Their overwhelming punishment, destroying every last one of them.
• This thing that I did deliberately is one of the things I told you not to denounce me for, because you do not know the full story, and there is a reason and purpose for it that you do not know about.
• It has no basis apart from what they say, and they have no evidence for it apart from their own lies and fabrications.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4758.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

q-4770.answer:
Surah Ash-Shura (42) — Consultation · 53 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4781.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4803.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4810.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

q-4813.answer:
Surah Al-Balad (90) — The City · 20 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Man is encompassed by Allah and His Bounties
• He was from the believers who worked righteous deeds, and advised each other to be patient with the harms of the people, and to be merciful with them.
• Then, along with these beautiful and pure characteristics, he was a believer in his heart, seeking the reward of that from Allah.
• It will be sealed over them and there will be no way for them to avoid it, nor will they have any way out.

q-4824.answer:
Surah At-Takaathur (102) — Competition · 8 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Result of Loving the World and Heedlessness of the Hereafter
• If you knew with true knowledge, you would not be diverted by rivalry for wealth away from seeking the abode of the Hereafter until you reach the graves.
• On that Day you all will be questioned concerning your gratitude towards the favors that Allah blessed you with, such as health, safety, sustenance and other things.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Surah Al-Anfaal (8) — The Spoils of War · 75 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• The Angels smite the Disbelievers upon capturing Their Souls
• In Allah's decision. This Ayah encompasses all relatives, not only the degrees of relative who do not have a fixed, designated share in the inheritance, as some people claim and use this Ayah to argue.
• This punishment is the recompense of the evil deeds that you have committed in the life of the world.

q-4841.answer: The story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) teaches patience through severe trials — betrayal by brothers, slavery, false accusation, and imprisonment — yet trust in Allah. He said: 'Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good' (12:90). The surah concludes: 'There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding' (12:111). See sources for key ayahs.

q-4853.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

Quran 2:16. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ. English: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.. Urdu: یہ وہ لوگ ہیں جنہوں نے ہدایت چھوڑ کر گمراہی خریدی، تو نہ تو ان کی تجارت ہی نے کچھ نفع دیا اور نہ وہ ہدایت یاب ہی ہوئے.

q-4865.answer:
Surah Yaseen (36) — Yaseen · 83 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Until a time that is known to Allah, may He be glorified and exalted.
• The like of mankind. So, He will re-create them as He created them in the first place.
• He only needs to command a thing once; it does not need to be repeated or confirmed.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4876.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

Quran 2:16. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ. English: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.. Urdu: یہ وہ لوگ ہیں جنہوں نے ہدایت چھوڑ کر گمراہی خریدی، تو نہ تو ان کی تجارت ہی نے کچھ نفع دیا اور نہ وہ ہدایت یاب ہی ہوئے.

Surah Al-Waaqia (56) — The Inevitable · 96 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Relentlessly pulverized. This was said by Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid, 'Ikrimah and Qatadah and others.
• We caused the seeds to grow with Our compassion and mercy and left them intact inside the earth as mercy for you.
• The angels will deliver the good news to them by saying, "Peace be upon you," i.
• It is shaken and moved violently over all of its surface and through its depths.

q-4888.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

q-4898.answer:
Surah Al-Jinn (72) — The Jinn · 28 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Jinns Affirmation that Allah does not have a Wife and Children
• The Jinns confess to Allah's Perfect Power
• Power to harm or give Guidance
• He particularly gives him additional guardian angels who protect him by the command of Allah and they accompany him with that which is with him of Allah's revelation.
• Among the Causes of the Transgression of the Jinns were that Humans sought Refuge with Them

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 72:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا. English: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.. q-4909.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4916.answer:
Surah Al-Lail (92) — The Night · 21 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Proving that Allah rewards those who intend good with success, while whoever intends evil is abandoned, and all of this is in accordance with a preordained decree.
• Hoping to attain the blessing of seeing Him in the final abode in the Gardens of Paradise.
• The recompense in the abode of the Hereafter.
• The righteous, pure, most pious person will be saved from the Fire.
• The actions of the servants that they have performed are also opposites and diverse.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4936.answer:
Surah Al-An'aam (6) — The Cattle · 165 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• In spite of all this, some of Allah's servants disbelieve in Him and hold others as partners and rivals with Him.
• Proof, according to Ibn 'Abbas and others among the Salaf.
• What will make you preceive, O believers, that the idolators will still not believe if the signs come.
• He made you dwell on the earth generation after generation, century after century and offspring after forefathers, according to Ibn Zayd and others.
• It is He Who is called Allah, throughout the heavens and the earth, that is, it is He who is worshipped, singled out, whose divinity is believed in by the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-4948.answer:
Surah Al-Kahf (18) — The Cave · 110 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• To those who oppose His Prophet ﷺ and disbelieve in His Book, He issues a warning of severe punishment hastened in this world and postponed to the world Hereafter.
• Their overwhelming punishment, destroying every last one of them.
• This thing that I did deliberately is one of the things I told you not to denounce me for, because you do not know the full story, and there is a reason and purpose for it that you do not know about.
• It has no basis apart from what they say, and they have no evidence for it apart from their own lies and fabrications.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

q-4972.answer:
Surah Ash-Shura (42) — Consultation · 53 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

q-4983.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5004.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5011.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5014.answer:
Surah Al-Balad (90) — The City · 20 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Man is encompassed by Allah and His Bounties
• He was from the believers who worked righteous deeds, and advised each other to be patient with the harms of the people, and to be merciful with them.
• Then, along with these beautiful and pure characteristics, he was a believer in his heart, seeking the reward of that from Allah.
• It will be sealed over them and there will be no way for them to avoid it, nor will they have any way out.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5033.answer:
Surah Al-Anfaal (8) — The Spoils of War · 75 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• The Angels smite the Disbelievers upon capturing Their Souls
• In Allah's decision. This Ayah encompasses all relatives, not only the degrees of relative who do not have a fixed, designated share in the inheritance, as some people claim and use this Ayah to argue.
• This punishment is the recompense of the evil deeds that you have committed in the life of the world.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5037.answer: The story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) teaches patience through severe trials — betrayal by brothers, slavery, false accusation, and imprisonment — yet trust in Allah. He said: 'Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good' (12:90). The surah concludes: 'There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding' (12:111). See sources for key ayahs.

This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

Surah Yaseen (36) — Yaseen · 83 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Until a time that is known to Allah, may He be glorified and exalted.
• The like of mankind. So, He will re-create them as He created them in the first place.
• He only needs to command a thing once; it does not need to be repeated or confirmed.

Surah Al-Waaqia (56) — The Inevitable · 96 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Relentlessly pulverized. This was said by Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid, 'Ikrimah and Qatadah and others.
• We caused the seeds to grow with Our compassion and mercy and left them intact inside the earth as mercy for you.
• The angels will deliver the good news to them by saying, "Peace be upon you," i.
• It is shaken and moved violently over all of its surface and through its depths.

q-5083.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5093.answer:
Surah Al-Jinn (72) — The Jinn · 28 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Jinns Affirmation that Allah does not have a Wife and Children
• The Jinns confess to Allah's Perfect Power
• Power to harm or give Guidance
• He particularly gives him additional guardian angels who protect him by the command of Allah and they accompany him with that which is with him of Allah's revelation.
• Among the Causes of the Transgression of the Jinns were that Humans sought Refuge with Them

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5104.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5111.answer:
Surah Al-Lail (92) — The Night · 21 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Proving that Allah rewards those who intend good with success, while whoever intends evil is abandoned, and all of this is in accordance with a preordained decree.
• Hoping to attain the blessing of seeing Him in the final abode in the Gardens of Paradise.
• The recompense in the abode of the Hereafter.
• The righteous, pure, most pious person will be saved from the Fire.
• The actions of the servants that they have performed are also opposites and diverse.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5126.answer:
Surah Al-An'aam (6) — The Cattle · 165 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• In spite of all this, some of Allah's servants disbelieve in Him and hold others as partners and rivals with Him.
• Proof, according to Ibn 'Abbas and others among the Salaf.
• What will make you preceive, O believers, that the idolators will still not believe if the signs come.
• He made you dwell on the earth generation after generation, century after century and offspring after forefathers, according to Ibn Zayd and others.
• It is He Who is called Allah, throughout the heavens and the earth, that is, it is He who is worshipped, singled out, whose divinity is believed in by the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5138.answer:
Surah Al-Kahf (18) — The Cave · 110 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• To those who oppose His Prophet ﷺ and disbelieve in His Book, He issues a warning of severe punishment hastened in this world and postponed to the world Hereafter.
• Their overwhelming punishment, destroying every last one of them.
• This thing that I did deliberately is one of the things I told you not to denounce me for, because you do not know the full story, and there is a reason and purpose for it that you do not know about.
• It has no basis apart from what they say, and they have no evidence for it apart from their own lies and fabrications.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

Quran 2:16. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ. q-5162.answer:
Surah Ash-Shura (42) — Consultation · 53 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:66
And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allah

• Quran 3:13
Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met - one fighting in the cause of Allah and another of disbelievers. They saw them [to be] twice their [own] number by [their] eyesight. But Allah supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed in that is a lesson for those of vision

• Quran 12:111
There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was the Qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe

q-5172.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5192.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

q-5201.answer:
Surah Al-Balad (90) — The City · 20 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Man is encompassed by Allah and His Bounties
• He was from the believers who worked righteous deeds, and advised each other to be patient with the harms of the people, and to be merciful with them.
• Then, along with these beautiful and pure characteristics, he was a believer in his heart, seeking the reward of that from Allah.
• It will be sealed over them and there will be no way for them to avoid it, nor will they have any way out.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Surah Al-Anfaal (8) — The Spoils of War · 75 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• The Angels smite the Disbelievers upon capturing Their Souls
• In Allah's decision. This Ayah encompasses all relatives, not only the degrees of relative who do not have a fixed, designated share in the inheritance, as some people claim and use this Ayah to argue.
• This punishment is the recompense of the evil deeds that you have committed in the life of the world.

q-5223.answer: The story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) teaches patience through severe trials — betrayal by brothers, slavery, false accusation, and imprisonment — yet trust in Allah. He said: 'Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good' (12:90). The surah concludes: 'There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding' (12:111). See sources for key ayahs.

q-5235.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

Quran 2:16. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ. English: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.. Urdu: یہ وہ لوگ ہیں جنہوں نے ہدایت چھوڑ کر گمراہی خریدی، تو نہ تو ان کی تجارت ہی نے کچھ نفع دیا اور نہ وہ ہدایت یاب ہی ہوئے.

Quran 2:38. Arabic: قُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًۭى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ. q-5247.answer:
Surah Yaseen (36) — Yaseen · 83 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Until a time that is known to Allah, may He be glorified and exalted.
• The like of mankind. So, He will re-create them as He created them in the first place.
• He only needs to command a thing once; it does not need to be repeated or confirmed.

Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

q-5268.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

q-5277.answer:
Surah Al-Jinn (72) — The Jinn · 28 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Jinns Affirmation that Allah does not have a Wife and Children
• The Jinns confess to Allah's Perfect Power
• Power to harm or give Guidance
• He particularly gives him additional guardian angels who protect him by the command of Allah and they accompany him with that which is with him of Allah's revelation.
• Among the Causes of the Transgression of the Jinns were that Humans sought Refuge with Them

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 72:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا. English: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.. Urdu: (اے پیغمبر لوگوں سے) کہہ دو کہ میرے پاس وحی آئی ہے کہ جنوں کی ایک جماعت نے (اس کتاب کو) سنا تو کہنے لگے کہ ہم نے ایک عجیب قرآن سنا.

Quran 72:2. Arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا. English: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.. Urdu: جو بھلائی کا رستہ بتاتا ہے سو ہم اس پر ایمان لے آئے۔ اور ہم اپنے پروردگار کے ساتھ کسی کو شریک نہیں بنائیں گے.

Quran 72:3. Arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا. English: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son. Urdu: اور یہ کہ ہمارے پروردگار کی عظمت (شان) بہت بڑی ہے اور وہ نہ بیوی رکھتا ہے نہ اولاد.

Quran 72:14. Arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا. English: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.. Urdu: اور یہ کہ ہم میں بعض فرمانبردار ہیں اور بعض (نافرمان) گنہگار ہیں۔ تو جو فرمانبردار ہوئے وہ سیدھے رستے پر چلے.

Quran 72:27. Arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا. English: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers. Urdu: ہاں جس پیغمبر کو پسند فرمائے تو اس (کو غیب کی باتیں بتا دیتا اور اس) کے آگے اور پیچھے نگہبان مقرر کر دیتا ہے.
