q-5287.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Surah Al-Lail (92) — The Night · 21 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Proving that Allah rewards those who intend good with success, while whoever intends evil is abandoned, and all of this is in accordance with a preordained decree.
• Hoping to attain the blessing of seeing Him in the final abode in the Gardens of Paradise.
• The recompense in the abode of the Hereafter.
• The righteous, pure, most pious person will be saved from the Fire.
• The actions of the servants that they have performed are also opposites and diverse.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5308.answer:
Surah Al-An'aam (6) — The Cattle · 165 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• In spite of all this, some of Allah's servants disbelieve in Him and hold others as partners and rivals with Him.
• Proof, according to Ibn 'Abbas and others among the Salaf.
• What will make you preceive, O believers, that the idolators will still not believe if the signs come.
• He made you dwell on the earth generation after generation, century after century and offspring after forefathers, according to Ibn Zayd and others.
• It is He Who is called Allah, throughout the heavens and the earth, that is, it is He who is worshipped, singled out, whose divinity is believed in by the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.

q-5320.answer:
Surah Al-Kahf (18) — The Cave · 110 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• To those who oppose His Prophet ﷺ and disbelieve in His Book, He issues a warning of severe punishment hastened in this world and postponed to the world Hereafter.
• Their overwhelming punishment, destroying every last one of them.
• This thing that I did deliberately is one of the things I told you not to denounce me for, because you do not know the full story, and there is a reason and purpose for it that you do not know about.
• It has no basis apart from what they say, and they have no evidence for it apart from their own lies and fabrications.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5332.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

Quran 2:16. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ. • He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

q-5354.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5374.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

q-5380.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5383.answer:
Surah Al-Balad (90) — The City · 20 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Man is encompassed by Allah and His Bounties
• He was from the believers who worked righteous deeds, and advised each other to be patient with the harms of the people, and to be merciful with them.
• Then, along with these beautiful and pure characteristics, he was a believer in his heart, seeking the reward of that from Allah.
• It will be sealed over them and there will be no way for them to avoid it, nor will they have any way out.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5401.answer:
Surah Al-Anfaal (8) — The Spoils of War · 75 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• The Angels smite the Disbelievers upon capturing Their Souls
• In Allah's decision. This Ayah encompasses all relatives, not only the degrees of relative who do not have a fixed, designated share in the inheritance, as some people claim and use this Ayah to argue.
• This punishment is the recompense of the evil deeds that you have committed in the life of the world.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5405.answer: The story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) teaches patience through severe trials — betrayal by brothers, slavery, false accusation, and imprisonment — yet trust in Allah. He said: 'Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good' (12:90). The surah concludes: 'There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding' (12:111). See sources for key ayahs.

Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

Surah Yaseen (36) — Yaseen · 83 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Until a time that is known to Allah, may He be glorified and exalted.
• The like of mankind. So, He will re-create them as He created them in the first place.
• He only needs to command a thing once; it does not need to be repeated or confirmed.

q-5440.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

Quran 2:16. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ. English: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.. q-5447.answer:
Surah Al-Waaqia (56) — The Inevitable · 96 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Relentlessly pulverized. This was said by Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid, 'Ikrimah and Qatadah and others.
• We caused the seeds to grow with Our compassion and mercy and left them intact inside the earth as mercy for you.
• The angels will deliver the good news to them by saying, "Peace be upon you," i.
• It is shaken and moved violently over all of its surface and through its depths.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5450.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5459.answer:
Surah Al-Jinn (72) — The Jinn · 28 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Jinns Affirmation that Allah does not have a Wife and Children
• The Jinns confess to Allah's Perfect Power
• Power to harm or give Guidance
• He particularly gives him additional guardian angels who protect him by the command of Allah and they accompany him with that which is with him of Allah's revelation.
• Among the Causes of the Transgression of the Jinns were that Humans sought Refuge with Them

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5469.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5476.answer:
Surah Al-Lail (92) — The Night · 21 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Proving that Allah rewards those who intend good with success, while whoever intends evil is abandoned, and all of this is in accordance with a preordained decree.
• Hoping to attain the blessing of seeing Him in the final abode in the Gardens of Paradise.
• The recompense in the abode of the Hereafter.
• The righteous, pure, most pious person will be saved from the Fire.
• The actions of the servants that they have performed are also opposites and diverse.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5492.answer:
Surah Ash-Shura (42) — Consultation · 53 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:66
And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allah

• Quran 3:13
Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met - one fighting in the cause of Allah and another of disbelievers. They saw them [to be] twice their [own] number by [their] eyesight. But Allah supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed in that is a lesson for those of vision

• Quran 12:111
There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was the Qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe

q-5499.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5515.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5521.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5539.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:16. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ. q-5545.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Quran 60:2. Arabic: إِن يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا۟ لَكُمْ أَعْدَآءًۭ وَيَبْسُطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلسُّوٓءِ وَوَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ. q-5553.answer:
Surah Al-Jinn (72) — The Jinn · 28 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Jinns Affirmation that Allah does not have a Wife and Children
• The Jinns confess to Allah's Perfect Power
• Power to harm or give Guidance
• He particularly gives him additional guardian angels who protect him by the command of Allah and they accompany him with that which is with him of Allah's revelation.
• Among the Causes of the Transgression of the Jinns were that Humans sought Refuge with Them

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5562.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5566.answer:
Surah Al-Lail (92) — The Night · 21 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Proving that Allah rewards those who intend good with success, while whoever intends evil is abandoned, and all of this is in accordance with a preordained decree.
• Hoping to attain the blessing of seeing Him in the final abode in the Gardens of Paradise.
• The recompense in the abode of the Hereafter.
• The righteous, pure, most pious person will be saved from the Fire.
• The actions of the servants that they have performed are also opposites and diverse.

q-5578.answer:
Surah Ash-Shura (42) — Consultation · 53 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

• Quran 2:66
And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allah

• Quran 3:13
Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met - one fighting in the cause of Allah and another of disbelievers. They saw them [to be] twice their [own] number by [their] eyesight. But Allah supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed in that is a lesson for those of vision

• Quran 12:111
There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was the Qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe

q-5585.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Quran 54:27. Arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ. English: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.. Urdu: (اے صالح) ہم ان کی آزمائش کے لئے اونٹنی بھیجنے والے ہیں تو تم ان کو دیکھتے رہو اور صبر کرو.
Quran 54:54. Arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ. English: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,. Urdu: جو پرہیزگار ہیں وہ باغوں اور نہروں میں ہوں گے.

q-5601.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5607.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

q-5631.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

q-5639.answer:
Surah Al-Jinn (72) — The Jinn · 28 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Jinns Affirmation that Allah does not have a Wife and Children
• The Jinns confess to Allah's Perfect Power
• Power to harm or give Guidance
• He particularly gives him additional guardian angels who protect him by the command of Allah and they accompany him with that which is with him of Allah's revelation.
• Among the Causes of the Transgression of the Jinns were that Humans sought Refuge with Them

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5648.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5652.answer:
Surah Al-Lail (92) — The Night · 21 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Proving that Allah rewards those who intend good with success, while whoever intends evil is abandoned, and all of this is in accordance with a preordained decree.
• Hoping to attain the blessing of seeing Him in the final abode in the Gardens of Paradise.
• The recompense in the abode of the Hereafter.
• The righteous, pure, most pious person will be saved from the Fire.
• The actions of the servants that they have performed are also opposites and diverse.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

q-5670.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5683.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5688.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5709.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5722.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

q-5735.answer:
Surah Ash-Shura (42) — Consultation · 53 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

q-5742.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5755.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5760.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5781.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5794.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5805.answer:
Surah Ash-Shura (42) — Consultation · 53 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

q-5812.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

q-5825.answer:
Surah An-Naba (78) — The Announcement · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Refutation against the Idolators' Denial of the Occurrence of the Day of Judgement
• Explaining the Day of Decision and what occurs during it
• The Day of Judgement. It is mentioned here to emphasize the fact that its occurrence has become close, because everything that is coming will certainly come to pass.
• What are they asking about? They are asking about the matter of the Day of Judgement, and it is the great news.
• They used to deny the evidences of Allah and His proofs for His creation, which He revealed to His Messengers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5830.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5843.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

sources.snippet: Quran 2:2. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ. English: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -. Urdu: یہ کتاب (قرآن مجید) اس میں کچھ شک نہیں (کہ کلامِ خدا ہے۔ خدا سے) ڈرنے والوں کی رہنما ہے.

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

Quran 2:16. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ. English: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.. q-5849.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5862.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

q-5880.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5896.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5909.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

• Quran 2:16
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

Quran 2:5. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ. English: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.. Urdu: یہی لوگ اپنے پروردگار (کی طرف) سے ہدایت پر ہیں اور یہی نجات پانے والے ہیں.

Quran 2:16. Arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ. q-5915.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5926.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5937.answer:
Surah Ash-Shura (42) — Consultation · 53 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

q-5942.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:66
And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allah

• Quran 3:13
Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met - one fighting in the cause of Allah and another of disbelievers. They saw them [to be] twice their [own] number by [their] eyesight. But Allah supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed in that is a lesson for those of vision

• Quran 12:111
There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was the Qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe

q-5944.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5955.answer:
Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Quran 2:2
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

• Quran 2:5
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

q-5970.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5978.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-5985.answer:
Surah Ash-Shura (42) — Consultation · 53 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He is Witness to their deeds, recording and enumerating them precisely, and He will requite them for them in full.
• Which is that if Allah willed, He could cause the wind to cease, in which case the ships would stop moving, or He could make the wind fierce, in which case the ships would be lost and destroyed.
• You are just a warner, and Allah is the Trustee of all affairs.

q-5992.answer:
Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

He was reciting it and I was learning it from his mouth. Verily, his mouth was moist with it when a snake leaped out at us. The Prophet ﷺ said, اقْتُلُوهَا (Kill it!)
